milestone: M43 External Mode Pack Update Admission

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Adds runtime-owned update admission to the active Mode Pack replacement path.
Keeps update trust/provenance checks in Rust before active policy mutation.
Persists bounded update-admission evidence as part of active replacement ledger evidence.
Gives scheduled callers deterministic update admission and fail-closed denial signals.

answers.strategic_capabilities: mode_pack_runtime with runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: modepack.replaceActive can admit an approved remote candidate as an update to the active remote Mode Pack only after current active evidence, approval, provenance, signer trust, revocation, and expiry are revalidated immediately before replacement.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Generic replacement swaps approved candidates but did not distinguish updates against the active remote pack or re-check signer revocation/expiry at active mutation time.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: A previously approved candidate could remain usable after signer trust changes, and headless callers could not prove a replacement was a current-state update admission.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M38 generic replacement, M39 provenance verification, M40 trust, M41 revocation, and M42 expiry because this enforces those signals at replacement time.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends modepack.replaceActive with explicit update_admission fields instead of adding a wrapper RPC.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds bounded mutation evidence only, not a report/history/digest/readiness/inspection surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime denies stale/untrusted update admission before active snapshot mutation and records bounded update evidence on successful replacement.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers receive deterministic bounded success/denial evidence for long-running external Mode Pack updates.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the minimal M43 update admission vertical slice.

exit_criteria: modepack.replaceActive accepts explicit update_admission evidence for approved remote candidates
update admission requires current active remote Mode Pack name/source evidence and rejects stale active state before mutation
update admission re-reads approved candidate, cached candidate, provenance, trusted signer, revocation, and expiry before mutation
revoked or expired signer after approval is denied before active snapshot mutation
same activation fingerprint and candidate name mismatch are denied before mutation
successful update replacement records bounded update_admission evidence and consumes approved candidate only after replacement
replay returns existing bounded update evidence without duplicate replacement or consumption events
VSIX protocol/client guards accept the bounded request/result shape and reject raw fields

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M43.1 changes active Mode Pack update mutation behavior; review must confirm this is runtime enforcement, not a wrapper surface.
